name: v1.11.2
body:
- Removed ads that showed up between turns, so now fullscreen ads are only shown after a game over.
- Fixed there being no page transitions when stylized page transitions were turned off.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adil192/ricochlime/compare/v1.11.1...v1.11.2

name: v1.11.1
body:
- Page transitions are faster by default and the old "faster page transitions" setting has been removed
- Disable the new "stylized page transitions" setting to use the system default
- Improved handling of the aim guide so the number of dots changes less often
- Allows the remove ads in-app-purchase to be bought for 10k coins instead of real money
- Added a message in settings about the remove ads in-app-purchase
- Removed the remove ads in-app-purchase on macOS, since macOS doesn't have ads
- The minimum macOS version is now 10.15
- Upgraded to Flutter 3.24

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adil192/ricochlime/compare/v1.11.0...v1.11.1

name: v1.11.0
body:

- Added some options to buy coins in the shop
- New Russian translation, thanks to @yurtpage in https://github.com/adil192/ricochlime/pull/50
- @yurtpage made their first contribution in https://github.com/adil192/ricochlime/pull/50

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adil192/ricochlime/compare/v1.10.1...v1.11.0
